issues.description: Method name/signature mismatch between the Bitmap24 header, its implementation, and usages in main: the template header declares a method 'void write(const std::string &i_filename);' while the implementation defines 'void Bitmap24::save(const std::string &i_filename)' and main calls 'bitmap.save(...)'. This mismatch will cause compilation errors (undefined method or unresolved symbol) and prevents students from building and running the example. The solution repository uses 'save', so the template header is inconsistent with both implementation and intended usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the header, implementation, and call sites consistent. Either change the header declaration in template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);' to match the implementation and usage, or rename the implementation and all usages to 'write(...)'. Prefer updating the template header to declare 'save' to match the solution and the implementation.

issues.description: The Bitmap24 file API method name is inconsistent between header and implementation in the template repository: Bitmap24.hpp declares a method named 'write()', but Bitmap24.cpp implements 'save()', and main.cpp calls 'save()'. The solution repository consistently uses 'save()'. This mismatch creates compilation errors and cognitive confusion for students mapping the class API (header) to its implementation and usage.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the declaration in template_repository/example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'write(const std::string &i_filename)' to 'save(const std::string &i_filename)' (or vice versa change the implementation and usages to 'write'). Prefer aligning the header to the implementation and usages (i.e., use 'save') to match the solution repository and avoid compilation/mental-mapping errors.
